selected_evidence.requirement: Create appworker and configure login-session resource limits
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the account, limits policy, and an actual appworker login session with soft/hard open-file limits of 8192 and process limits of 256.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after evidence shows AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64.

Captures the healthy baseline, acknowledged native reboot, boot ID change from d546da19-398f-473c-b85c-afdd17037523 to 4f398ef8-60df-46e1-b6ed-b0e3aaa0f112, and recovered state with zero failed units and persistent effective limits.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
if getent passwd appworker >/dev/null; then getent passwd appworker; else printf 'appworker=absent\n'; fi
printf 'pam_limits_refs:\n'; grep -R '^[[:space:]]*session[[:space:]].*pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'limits_dir:\n'; ls -ld /etc/security/limits.d
printf 'health:\n'; systemctl is-system-running || true
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager || true
commands.stdout:
node=node1 ip=10.100.105.10
boot_id=d546da19-398f-473c-b85c-afdd17037523
os=almalinux 9.6
kernel=5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64
appworker=absent
pam_limits_refs:
/etc/pam.d/fingerprint-auth:session     required      pam_limits.so
/etc/pam.d/password-auth:[REDACTED]]]]     required      pam_limits.so
/etc/pam.d/smartcard-auth:session     required      pam_limits.so
/etc/pam.d/system-auth:session     required      pam_limits.so
/etc/pam.d/runuser:session		required	pam_limits.so
limits_dir:
drwxr-xr-x. 2 root root 6 Mar 12  2025 /etc/security/limits.d
health:
running

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd appworker >/dev/null; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker; fi
umask 022
printf '%s\n' 'appworker soft nofile 8192' 'appworker hard nofile 8192' 'appworker soft nproc 256' 'appworker hard nproc 256' > /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
restorecon /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf 2>/dev/null || true
getent passwd appworker
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
sed -n '1,10p' /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
commands.stdout:
appworker:x:1000:1000::/home/appworker:/bin/bash
root:root 644 /etc/security/limits.d/90-appworker.conf
appworker soft nofile 8192
appworker hard nofile 8192
appworker soft nproc 256
appworker hard nproc 256

commands.command:
set -eu
runuser -l appworker -c 'printf "user=%s home=%s shell=%s\n" "$(id -un)" "$HOME" "$SHELL"; printf "nofile_soft="; ulimit -Sn; printf "nofile_hard="; ulimit -Hn; printf "nproc_soft="; ulimit -Su; printf "nproc_hard="; ulimit -Hu; printf "kernel_limits:\n"; grep -E "^(Max processes|Max open files)" /proc/self/limits'
printf 'account_status='; passwd -S appworker | awk '{print $2}'
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
commands.stdout:
user=appworker home=/home/appworker shell=/bin/bash
nofile_soft=8192
nofile_hard=8192
nproc_soft=256
nproc_hard=256
kernel_limits:
Max processes             256                  256                  processes 
Max open files            8192                 8192                 files     
account_status=LK
boot_id=d546da19-398f-473c-b85c-afdd17037523
system_state=running
